context: A casual living-room conversation between a mother and her aunt about the neighborhood
purpose: Teach: 伊藤/吉田/松本/小林/村上/主婦/タバコ/入り口

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、聞いた？商店街の入り口にあった伊藤さんのお店、閉めちゃったらしいよ。
lines.en: Hey, did you hear? Ito-san's shop near the shopping street entrance apparently closed down.
lines.style: Casual sisterly tone with gentle surprise and gossip.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ええ、吉田さんから聞いたわ。借金がかなりあったみたいね。
lines.en: Yeah, I heard from Yoshida-san. Apparently they had quite a bit of debt.
lines.style: Lowered voice, knowing tone, leaning in confidentially.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: やっぱり？松本さんも、バブルの頃に無理して商業ビル建てたって言ってたし。
lines.en: I knew it. Matsumoto-san also said they overextended building commercial buildings during the bubble years.
lines.style: Sighing in agreement with hands wrapped around a warm teacup.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 小林さんなんて、ずっと専業主婦だったのに今パートに出てるのよ。
lines.en: Even Kobayashi-san, who was always a full-time housewife, is now out working part-time.
lines.style: Pitying yet matter-of-fact, neighborhood-update voice., voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうなんだ。あ、そういえば村上さんのご主人、タバコやめたんだって。奥さんが過剰に心配してたから。
lines.en: Really? Oh, speaking of which, Murakami-san's husband quit smoking. His wife was worrying excessively.
lines.style: Brightening up, shifting to a lighter piece of news.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: あら、いいことじゃない。あくまでも体のためだもの、続くといいけど。
lines.en: Oh, well that's a good thing. It's purely for his health, so I hope he keeps it up.
lines.style: Warm, slightly skeptical aunt tone with a knowing smile.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 恐らく奥さんの監視がきついから、しばらくは大丈夫でしょ。
lines.en: Probably with his wife watching so closely, he'll manage to stick with it for a while.
lines.style: Teasing laugh, sharing a small joke between family.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、この辺もずいぶん変わったわよね。お茶もう一杯どう？
lines.en: Haha, this neighborhood has really changed a lot, hasn't it? Want another cup of tea?
lines.style: Soft chuckle, warm hosting tone wrapping up the topic.
